streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream A contains substrate and solvent. Flow rate set to 2/3 of total to match stoichiometry and mixing ratio.
From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream B contains Nitric Acid. Concentration doubled relative to A to maintain 2:1 stoichiometry at equal molar flow. Flow rate set to 1/3 of total.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Add nitric acid to substrate to control exotherm and prevent over-nitration. Static mixer ensures rapid mixing to manage Da > 1.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas streams if solvent is volatile (optional, not strictly required by plan)
Heat streams to 60 C before mixing
post_reactor_steps: Quench with Water or Base to neutralize excess acid
chemistry_notes: Electrophilic aromatic nitration is highly exothermic. Flow chemistry provides superior heat transfer (Da_th = 0.0016) and mixing control (Da = 3.1) compared to batch. Dinitration requires precise residence time control to avoid over-oxidation. Industrial Batch Solvent is assumed compatible with 60 C. No light source required.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation estimated 11.9 min (range 5.2-36.0 min). Analogy 1 used 60 min at 120 C; our reaction is at 60 C, so longer time is expected, but flow intensification allows reduction from 240 min batch. 11.9 min is within calculated range.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (60 C) to maintain selectivity and safety. Analogy 1 used 120 C but with different solvent/catalyst.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation states BPR not required (T=60 C, safe margin). Solvent bp unknown but assumed >80 C for industrial batch solvent.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA preferred for thermal stability and chemical resistance to nitric acid. FEP is also acceptable but PFA has higher temp rating.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Calculation used 0.1 M. Analogy 1 used 1.0 M, but lower concentration helps manage exotherm and viscosity in flow.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculated as 5.93 mL based on tau=11.9 min and Q=0.5 mL/min. Matches Analogy 1 volume (7.85 mL) order of magnitude.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm ID used in calculation for Re=10.6 (laminar) and Pe=136 (plug flow). Ensures good heat transfer.
